extracted.subtask_description: Historic newspaper page containing multiple Associated Press wartime news dispatches and human-interest war correspondent pieces—primarily battlefield reports, policy announcements, and obituaries. Useful for understanding mid-1940s newspaper war reporting content and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wartime manufacturing restrictions on nonessential metal goods
rubrics_metrics.description: "No metal may be used in the manufacture of baseball or swimming pool equipment, race tracks, ski articles, skating rinks, and athletic equipment, games or trophies..." (announced by Morgenthau Jr., Secretary of the Treasury, in the context of wartime production and material conservation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Context: part of wartime economic/policy measures to conserve metal for essential war production. The announcement lists specific nonessential items explicitly prohibited from using metal in manufacture; the line appears in a report of Treasury/administration statements about shipping and relief supplies. No scoring guidance provided—this is a regulatory/production restriction reported as news.
